info.name: Adesua - Member A (health, auth, categories, admin)
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint Member A owns, matching docs/API_CONTRACT.md. Each request has saved example responses (success and errors) under it.

**How to use**
1. Import this file and `adesua-local.postman_environment.json`, then choose the **Adesua local** environment (top right).
2. Start the backend: in `backend/`, run `npm run dev` (and `npm run seed -- --yes` once, to add the test accounts).
3. Run **Auth > Log in** first. It saves the token as `{{token}}`, and the other requests send it automatically.
4. Run **Create a category** before Rename and Delete, and **List users** before Deactivate or reactivate a user. They save the IDs those requests need.

Members B and C keep their own collection files in docs/postman/, so nobody edits the same file.

request.description:
Purpose: Create a student or instructor account. Returns a login token.

Access: Public. Limited to 20 sign-up or login attempts per 15 minutes per IP address.

Body (JSON):
- `name` (required): 2 to 50 characters
- `email` (required): a valid email address
- `password` (required): at least 8 characters, with a letter and a number
- `role` (optional): `student` (the default) or `instructor`. Sign-up can never create an admin.

Parameters: none.

This request saves the returned token as `{{token}}`.

response.name: Invalid fields (400)
Email already used (409)

request.description:
Purpose: Log in. Returns a token that the other requests send automatically.

Access: Public. Limited to 20 sign-up or login attempts per 15 minutes per IP address.

Body (JSON):
- `email` (required)
- `password` (required)

Every seeded test account uses the password `Demo1234`: admin@example.com (admin), kwame@example.com and ama@example.com (instructors), akosua@example.com, kojo@example.com and esi@example.com (students).

Parameters: none.

This request saves the returned token as `{{token}}`. Log in as admin@example.com before using the Categories and Admin requests.

response.name: Empty password (400)
Deactivated account (403)

request.description:
Purpose: Create a category. The slug is made from the name.

Access: Admin.

Body (JSON):
- `name` (required): 2 to 40 characters, including at least one letter or number. It can't match an existing category's name, ignoring capital letters.

Parameters: none.

This request saves the new category's `_id` as `{{categoryId}}`, which Rename and Delete use.

response.name: Name too short (400)
Name already used (409)
Not an admin (403)

request.description:
Purpose: Rename a category. Its slug changes to match.

Access: Admin.

Body (JSON):
- `name` (required): same rules as Create a category.

Parameters:
- `:id` in the path: the category's `_id`. Uses `{{categoryId}}` from Create a category.

Purpose: Delete a category that no course uses (in any status).

Access: Admin.

Body: none.

Parameters:
- `:id` in the path: the category's `_id`. Uses `{{categoryId}}` from Create a category.

response.name: Category has courses (400)

query.description: Part of a name or email, ignoring capital letters

request.description:
Purpose: List users, newest first, with search, a role filter and pages.

Access: Admin.

Body: none.

Parameters (query):
- `search`: part of a name or email, ignoring capital letters
- `role`: `student`, `instructor` or `admin`
- `page`: default 1
- `limit`: default 10, max 50

Tick a parameter in the Params tab to use it.

This request saves the first user's `_id` as `{{userId}}`, which Deactivate or reactivate a user uses.

query.description: Part of a name or email, ignoring capital letters

response.name: Invalid role (400)
No token (401)

request.description:
Purpose: Deactivate or reactivate an account. A deactivated user gets 403 at login and on every request.

Access: Admin. Admins can't deactivate their own account.

Body (JSON):
- `isActive` (required): `true` or `false`. It must be a real true or false, not text like `"yes"`.

Parameters:
- `:id` in the path: the user's `_id`. Uses `{{userId}}` from List users.

This request sends `false`. Change it to `true` to reactivate the account.

response.name: Deactivating yourself (400)
isActive isn't true or false (400)
